content: तिरस्क(स्का)रिणी .²1 A curtain, veil; सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करणिमन्तरा <ls>Rām. 2. 15. 20</ls>; तिरस्करिण्यो जलदा भवन्ति <ls>Ku. 1. 14</ls>; <ls>M. 2. 1</ls>. .²2 An outer tent, screen of cloth. .²3 A kind of magical veil (or spell) rendering the wearer invisible, <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. and <ls>V. 2</ls>, {%inter alia%}. It is properly the science or art possessed by celestial beings of rendering themselves invisible by repeating some {%Mantras%}.
